renderings.value: Somehow I just don't feel like hurrying. I have enough time.
For some reason the message text was corrupted, so I restored it before reading.
I often find myself falling for jokers, regardless of their looks.
For some reason the microphone didn't work earlier.
Although an increase of unmarried mothers is needed in order to escape the declining birth rate for some reason public opinion in Japan is avoiding this argument.
For some reason, I don't cope well with those recognized as hardliners.
For some reason it didn't go well, shot down at every attempt, and he led a sad "History of no girlfriend = Age" life.
For some reason economic booms have names taken from Japanese mythology given to them.
She looks blue for some reason.
He looks blue for some reason.
Since many organizations are putting effort into recycling in order to restore the natural environment, why won't you contribute to reforestation?
I wrote him to ask why.
I really like a cloudy sky. Why? I don't even know.
An injury like this should hurt, but it doesn't at all, for some reason.
